verses.text: A song for going up to worship. Of David. I was glad when they said to me, "Let's go to the house of the LORD!"
Jerusalem, our feet are standing inside your gates!
Jerusalem is built as a city where everything fits closely together.
The tribes go up there, the tribes of the LORD, as the law for Israel says, to thank the name of the LORD.
There the thrones for judging stand, the thrones of the family of David.
Pray for peace in Jerusalem. May those who love you be safe.
May there be peace inside your walls and safety in your palaces.
For the sake of my family and friends, I will say, "May peace be with you."
For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will work for your good.
